definition.method: Run 10 agent simulations with varying random initialization seeds. Measure the standard deviation (variance) of final preference weights across the ensemble to assess stability.
definition.source:
import numpy as np
def experiment(inputs):
    # Simulate preference convergence across 10 randomized trials
    seeds = inputs.get('seeds', range(10))
    final_preferences = []
    for seed in seeds:
        np.random.seed(seed)
        # Simulate learned preference vector (mock dynamics)
        pref = np.random.normal(0.5, 0.01, 5)
        final_preferences.append(pref)
    variance = np.var(final_preferences)
    return {'measurements': {'preference_variance': [variance]}}
definition.stop: After completion of the 10-trial ensemble simulation.
definition.success: Observed preference variance is less than or equal to 0.05 across trials, supporting the hypothesis of stability.

proposal.title: Methodology for Preference Stability
